rows.grounds: bahuvrīhi/compound adjective qualifying kṣetraṃ; highest excellence
noun in apposition specifying the sacred place
proper name of the mountain, in apposition to śailaṃ

items.question: What exalted status is attributed to the Mandāraka mountain as a sacred site?
premises: The site is declared an unsurpassed and supreme sacred place.
This sacred place is identified as the Mandāraka mountain.
The declaration is addressed directly to the beloved.
items.inference: The Mandāraka mountain is affirmed as the highest sacred place.
uncertainties: The exact case relation of śailaṃ mandārakaṃ in apposition to kṣetraṃ is contextually inferred.
items.plain_english: O beloved, it is the unsurpassed, supreme sacred place—the Mandāraka mountain.
